title: Automation Bias and Deskilling in Radiology AI: A Confidence-stratified Triage Model for Workflow Integration.
zh_title: 影像 AI 的自动化偏差与技能退化
summary: 文章讨论放射科 AI 带来的自动化偏差与技能退化风险，并提出置信度分层分诊的整合模型。
key_points: AI 错误输出会降低判读准确性，与经验无关

reason: 同行评审的观点与框架提案，聚焦人机协作安全，无前瞻性实证数据，属值得一看档
abstract: [Radiology. Artificial intelligence] Radiology is adopting artificial intelligence (AI) faster than it is studying what AI does to radiologists' perceptual expertise and interpretive skill. The question has partly shifted from whether these tools perform well on benchmark tasks to what happens to clinical judgment when use of these tools becomes routine. Two risks accompany this transition: automation bias, the tendency to follow AI suggestions without adequate scrutiny, and deskilling, the erosion of perceptual and interpretive ability through disuse, typically revealed when AI support is withdrawn. Incorrect AI output degrades accuracy regardless of experience, the benefit of assistance varies unpredictably across readers and tasks, and performance falls after AI withdrawal; neither risk has been studied longitudinally in radiology. A confidence-stratified triage model is proposed in which calibrated AI confidence, not findings alone, routes cases to low-, intermediate-, or high-confidence streams: output withheld until independent reading, shown with uncertainty signals and a checklist, or shown with random blinded audit. Demonstrated local confidence calibration is a precondition for deployment, and stream thresholds and audit rates should be weighted by task and potential clinical harm, not error probability alone. Rather than applying one workflow to every case, the model redistributes radiologist attention to where AI error is most likely and most consequential, operationalizing four principles: keeping the radiologist in the decision loop, making AI uncertainty visible, inserting targeted cognitive friction, and governing the human-AI interaction as a system. A research agenda to determine whether these countermeasures reduce automation bias and skill erosion in practice is also proposed.
zh_abstract: [Radiology. Artificial intelligence] 放射科采用人工智能（AI）的速度，快于研究AI对放射科医生知觉专长和判读技能影响的速度。问题已部分从这些工具在基准任务上表现是否良好，转变为当这些工具的使用成为常规时临床判断会发生什么。这一转变伴随两种风险：自动化偏差（automation bias），即未经充分审视就遵循AI建议的倾向；以及技能退化（deskilling），即因不使用而导致知觉和判读能力侵蚀，通常在AI支持被撤除时显现。无论经验如何，错误的AI输出都会降低准确性；辅助带来的获益在不同阅片者和任务间不可预测地变化；并且在撤除AI后性能下降；这两种风险均未在放射学中开展纵向研究。提出一种置信度分层分诊模型，其中由校准后的AI置信度（而非仅依据发现）将病例分流至低、中、高置信度流程：在独立阅片前暂不显示输出；显示输出并附带不确定性信号和检查清单；或显示输出并随机盲法审核。已证明的本地置信度校准是部署的前提条件，流程阈值和审核率应根据任务和潜在临床危害加权，而不仅依据错误概率。该模型不是对每个病例应用同一种工作流程，而是将放射科医生的注意力重新分配到AI错误最可能出现且后果最严重的地方，从而落实四项原则：使放射科医生留在决策环路中、让AI不确定性可见、插入有针对性的认知摩擦，以及将人-AI交互作为一个系统进行治理。还提出一个研究议程，以确定这些对策在实践中是否能减少自动化偏差和技能侵蚀。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Second Affiliated Hospital, Zhejiang University, School of Medicine; conditions: Acute Ischemic Stroke; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: PHASE3; enrollment: 826; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This multicenter, prospective, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of intravenous recombinant human prourokinase (rhPro-UK) in patients with acute ischemic stroke treated more than 4.5 hours and up to 24 hours after stroke onset, selected using a noncontrast computed tomography-based artificial intelligence (CT-AI) tissue-window algorithm. A total of 826 participants will be randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive intravenous rhPro-UK or matching placebo, in addition to guideline-recommended standard stroke care. title: A physics-informed peripheral hemodynamic digital twin for personalized estimation of arterial stiffness

abstract: Arterial stiffness, commonly assessed by pulse wave velocity (PWV), is an important biomarker of cardiovascular risk, yet conventional PWV measurements require dual-site recordings that limit scalability in clinical settings. Here we introduce a physics-informed peripheral hemodynamic digital twin framework for estimating central-brachial arterial stiffness from a single brachial pressure waveform. Using our laboratory-developed cuff device, high-resolution brachial pulse waveforms were collected in a cohort of 118 subjects. The digital twin then personalizes a reduced-order wave propagation model through PDE-constrained optimization, generating a compact parameter space that encodes ventricular–vascular characteristics relevant to stiffness. Incorporating digital-twin-derived parameters improved PWV estimation on a blind test cohort ( r = 0.67, RMSE = 1.12 m/s) compared with a baseline model using only age and blood pressure ( r = 0.22, RMSE = 1.90 m/s). These results indicate that physics-informed digital twins can enable scalable, noninvasive assessment of vascular aging from accessible peripheral waveforms.
zh_abstract: 动脉僵硬度通常通过脉搏波速度（PWV）评估，是心血管风险的重要生物标志物，但传统PWV测量需要双部位记录，限制了临床环境中的可扩展性。在此，我们引入一个物理信息驱动（physics-informed）的外周血流动力学数字孪生框架，用于从单个肱动脉压力波形估计中心-肱动脉僵硬度。使用我们实验室开发的袖带设备，在118名受试者队列中采集了高分辨率肱动脉脉搏波形。数字孪生随后通过偏微分方程（PDE）约束优化个性化一个降阶波传播模型，生成一个紧凑参数空间，编码与僵硬度相关的心室-血管特征。与仅使用年龄和血压的基线模型（r = 0.22，RMSE = 1.90 m/s）相比，纳入数字孪生衍生参数在盲测队列上改善了PWV估计（r = 0.67，RMSE = 1.12 m/s）。这些结果表明，物理信息驱动的数字孪生能够利用可获取的外周波形实现可扩展、无创的血管老化评估。

abstract: [Oral diseases] Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have shown promise for the detection of periodontal disease. This study aimed to synthesize current evidence on the diagnostic performance of AI models applied to cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) for periodontal disease. A comprehensive literature search of MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, and Embase was conducted to identify studies on AI-assisted diagnosis of periodontal disease using CBCT published up to December 2025. The Quality Assessment of Diagnostic Accuracy Studies-2 (QUADAS-2) tool was used to assess the risk of bias. Among 10,099 records screened, eight studies met the inclusion criteria. These studies indicate that AI models, predominantly based on convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures applied to CBCT images, have substantial potential for detecting periodontal bone loss and related conditions. However, diagnostic performance metrics varied markedly across studies, and direct comparisons with human clinicians produced inconsistent findings, underscoring the need for more rigorous study designs and standardized datasets. Despite limitations arising from heterogeneous methodologies and non-standardized data collection, CBCT-based AI models show considerable promise for enhancing periodontal disease diagnosis. Further high-quality, methodologically robust research is warranted to validate and optimize these approaches for clinical use. PROSPERO: CRD420251273846.
zh_abstract: [口腔疾病] 人工智能（AI）的近期进展已在牙周病检测方面显示出前景。本研究旨在综合当前关于应用于锥形束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）的AI模型对牙周病诊断性能的证据。对MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Science和Embase进行了全面文献检索，以识别截至2025年12月发表的关于使用CBCT进行AI辅助牙周病诊断的研究。使用诊断准确性研究质量评估-2（QUADAS-2）工具评估偏倚风险。在筛选的10,099条记录中，有8项研究符合纳入标准。这些研究表明，主要基于卷积神经网络（CNN）架构并应用于CBCT图像的AI模型在检测牙周骨丧失及相关状况方面具有相当大的潜力。然而，各研究之间的诊断性能指标差异显著，且与人类临床医生的直接比较产生了不一致的结果，这凸显了需要更严谨的研究设计和标准化数据集。尽管存在由异质性方法和非标准化数据收集引起的局限性，基于CBCT的AI模型在增强牙周病诊断方面显示出相当大的前景。需要进一步开展高质量、方法学稳健的研究，以验证和优化这些方法以供临床使用。PROSPERO：CRD420251273846。

abstract: [Clinical & experimental ophthalmology] Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative technology in the fields of medicine and ophthalmology. Recent advances in machine learning, deep learning and convolutional neural networks have significantly improved cataract detection and grading, intraocular lens power calculations, surgical decision-making, risk prediction and patient education. Intraoperative AI-assisted surgical phase recognition, workflow analysis, real-time guidance, robotic technologies and femtosecond laser integration can improve surgical precision, efficiency and safety. AI has shown promise in predicting visual outcomes, detecting postoperative complications and facilitating telemedicine follow-up. Though challenges with AI include transparency, data diversity, regulatory oversight and clinical validation, continued advances are expected to further personalise cataract surgery, support clinical decision-making, optimise surgical performance and improve patient outcomes. This narrative summarises the current and emerging applications of AI in preoperative, intraoperative and postoperative management of cataracts.
zh_abstract: [Clinical & experimental ophthalmology] 人工智能（AI）已成为医学和眼科领域的一项变革性技术。机器学习、深度学习和卷积神经网络的最新进展显著改善了白内障检测与分级、人工晶状体度数计算、手术决策、风险预测和患者教育。术中 AI 辅助的手术阶段识别、工作流程分析、实时引导、机器人技术和飞秒激光整合可提高手术精确性、效率和安全性。AI 在预测视力结局、检测术后并发症和促进远程医疗随访方面显示出前景。尽管 AI 面临透明度、数据多样性、监管监督和临床验证等挑战，但持续进展预计将进一步实现白内障手术个性化、支持临床决策、优化手术表现并改善患者结局。本叙述性综述总结了 AI 在白内障术前、术中和术后管理中的当前和新兴应用。

abstract: Objective: To evaluate large language model (LLM) generation of type 2 diabetes (T2DM) phenotyping SQL and the effect of database implementation context. Materials and Methods: Eight publicly accessible LLM-based systems generated SQL under progressively richer prompts using synthetic and University of North Carolina (UNC) Health electronic health record (EHR) data, both based on the Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership (OMOP) model. Outputs were compared with the Electronic Medical Records and Genomics (eMERGE) T2DM reference phenotype using SQL executability, F1, positive predictive value (PPV), and recall. Results: Fewer than 55% of limited-context synthetic outputs and no limited-context UNC EHR outputs executed without modification. Detailed codebooks (L3) increased executability to 81.3% in synthetic OMOP and 100% in UNC EHR; adding sample rows (L4) increased synthetic executability to 100%. Limited-context recall was as low as 0.01, whereas high-context outputs achieved recall [≥]0.99 at synthetic L4 and >0.90 at UNC L3, although UNC PPV remained substantially lower than recall. At the highest available context levels, Beta F1 ranged from 0.72-0.99 in synthetic OMOP and 0.57-0.68 in UNC EHR; all UNC models exceeded the diagnosis-code baseline (F1=0.54). The top synthetic performer fell from F1=0.99 to 0.64 on UNC EHR. Discussion: Richer database context was associated with more consistent SQL executability and recall, while model rankings varied across datasets. Conclusion: LLMs can generate clinically meaningful T2DM phenotyping SQL when provided with sufficient database context, but limited PPV in real-world data underscores the need for local validation.
zh_abstract: 【目的】评估大语言模型（large language model, LLM）生成2型糖尿病（type 2 diabetes, T2DM）表型SQL的能力以及数据库实施背景的影响。【材料与方法】八个可公开访问的基于LLM的系统在逐渐丰富的提示下生成SQL，使用合成数据和北卡罗来纳大学（University of North Carolina, UNC）Health电子健康记录（electronic health record, EHR）数据，二者均基于观察性医疗结果合作组织（Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership, OMOP）模型。使用SQL可执行性、F1、阳性预测值（positive predictive value, PPV）和召回率，将输出与电子病历与基因组学（Electronic Medical Records and Genomics, eMERGE）T2DM参考表型进行比较。【结果】有限上下文的合成输出中少于55%在未经修改的情况下可执行，且有限上下文的UNC EHR输出中没有任何一个在未经修改的情况下可执行。详细的代码本（L3）将合成OMOP中的可执行性提高至81.3%，将UNC EHR中的可执行性提高至100%；添加样本行（L4）将合成数据的可执行性提高至100%。有限上下文的召回率低至0.01，而高上下文输出在合成L4中达到召回率≥0.99，在UNC L3中达到>0.90，尽管UNC PPV仍显著低于召回率。在可获得的最高上下文水平下，Beta F1在合成OMOP中范围为0.72-0.99，在UNC EHR中为0.57-0.68；所有UNC模型均超过诊断代码基线（F1=0.54）。表现最佳的合成模型在UNC EHR上从F1=0.99降至0.64。【讨论】更丰富的数据库背景与更一致的SQL可执行性和召回率相关，而模型排名在不同数据集间有所变化。【结论】当提供足够的数据库背景时，LLMs能够生成具有临床意义的T2DM表型SQL，但真实世界数据中有限的PPV凸显了本地验证的必要性。

title: EM-BENCH: A Reproducible Framework for Benchmarking Guideline-Concordant Clinical Decision Making in Large Language Models
zh_title: EM-BENCH：大模型指南一致性临床决策基准
summary: medRxiv预印本，发布经医师验证的急诊指南一致性基准，含210个二元临床情景，评测149种模型配置。

abstract: Background Physicians increasingly use artificial intelligence tools to support clinical work, yet there is no accepted standard for measuring the competency of large language models (LLMs) in clinical decision support. We developed EM-BENCH, a physician-validated, deterministically scored benchmark for evaluating whether models reliably apply the American College of Emergency Physicians (ACEP) guidelines to clinical decisions. Methods EM-BENCH comprises 210 binary clinical vignettes covering all 70 critical questions across 25 ACEP clinical policies. We evaluated 149 LLM configurations representing 79 base models using prespecified answers and deterministic scoring. Each vignette had a prespecified correct answer to a binary yes-or-no question based on an ACEP recommendation. We examined associations between accuracy and model access tier (closed-access vs. open-weight models), model size, release date, clinical policy, recommendation evidence level, and reasoning settings. Results No configuration achieved complete guideline concordance. The highest performing configuration answered 207 of 210 vignettes correctly (98.6%). Closed-access models outperformed open-weight models (median accuracy, 91% vs. 63%; Hodges-Lehmann location shift, 26 percentage points; 99% CI, 20 to 33; adjusted P<0.001). Among open-weight model families, a 10-fold increase in parameter count was associated with a 14-percentage-point increase in accuracy (99% CI, 7.7 to 20; adjusted P<0.001). Across all models, accuracy increased by 8.9 percentage points per release year (99% CI, 3.6 to 14; adjusted P<0.001). Neither enabling a thinking mode (pseudomedian change, 0.95 percentage points; 99% CI, -2.6 to 3.1; adjusted P=1.00) nor high versus low reasoning effort (0.91 percentage points; 99% CI, -0.69 to 3.1; adjusted P=0.56) consistently improved accuracy. Conclusions Contemporary LLMs showed improving but incomplete ability to apply ACEP guidelines. Concordance varied markedly across models and was associated with access tier, size, and release recency, while additional inference-time reasoning offered inconsistent benefit. Specialty-specific, physician-validated benchmarks may provide a reproducible assessment of LLMs' ability to make guideline-concordant clinical decisions.
zh_abstract: 【背景】医生越来越多地使用人工智能工具支持临床工作，但目前尚无公认标准来衡量大语言模型（LLMs）在临床决策支持方面的能力。我们开发了 EM-BENCH，这是一个经医生验证、采用确定性评分、用于评估模型能否可靠地将美国急诊医师学会（ACEP）指南应用于临床决策的基准。【方法】EM-BENCH 包含210个二元临床病例情景，覆盖25项 ACEP 临床政策中的所有70个关键问题。我们使用预设答案和确定性评分评估了代表79个基础模型的149种 LLM 配置。每个病例情景均基于一项 ACEP 推荐意见，对二元是/否问题设有一个预设正确答案。我们考察了准确性与模型访问层级（闭源访问模型 vs. 开放权重模型）、模型规模、发布日期、临床政策、推荐证据级别及推理设置之间的关联。【结果】没有任何配置达到完全符合指南。表现最佳的配置正确回答了210个病例情景中的207个（98.6%）。闭源访问模型优于开放权重模型（中位准确率，91% vs. 63%；Hodges-Lehmann 位置偏移，26个百分点；99% CI，20至33；校正 P<0.001）。在开放权重模型家族中，参数数量增加10倍与准确率提高14个百分点相关（99% CI，7.7至20；校正 P<0.001）。在所有模型中，准确率每发布年份增加8.9个百分点（99% CI，3.6至14；校正 P<0.001）。启用思考模式（伪中位数变化，0.95个百分点；99% CI，-2.6至3.1；校正 P=1.00）与高推理强度相对于低推理强度（0.91个百分点；99% CI，-0.69至3.1；校正 P=0.56）均未能持续提高准确率。【结论】当代 LLMs 在应用 ACEP 指南方面表现出不断提高但仍不完整的能力。不同模型之间的一致性差异显著，并与访问层级、规模和发布新近程度相关，而额外的推理时推理带来的益处不一致。专科特异性、经医生验证的基准可能为评估 LLMs 做出符合指南的临床决策的能力提供可重复的评估。

title: Large language models detect methodological errors that human peer review misses in clinical trials

abstract: Peer review is the principal quality control of published research, but methodological errors can go undetected. In an earlier experiment with errors inserted into three reports of randomized clinical trials, untrained human reviewers achieved a mean major-error detection score of 27%. Here, we tested whether 15 large language models (LLMs), including four open-weight models, detect the same errors. Their major-error detection scores ranged from 53% to 96%. To reduce the risk of memorization, we repeated the test on three clinical trials published in 2026. Scores ranged from 51% to 99%, and from 66% to 87% for the open-weight models. Notably, LLMs still flagged 2% to 29% of the error types in control reports without inserted errors, most often conclusions not supported by the results and missing reasons why screened patients were not enrolled. Across the 12 models, mean review times ranged from 1.4 to 16.3 minutes. Opus 5.5 achieved the highest major-error detection score (99%), while GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna offered cost-effective alternatives with scores of 92% and 87%, respectively. Together, these tests provide a benchmark for specialized review models and suggest that relying on human peer review alone may leave avoidable methodological errors undetected.
zh_abstract: 同行评议是已发表研究的主要质量控制手段，但方法学错误可能未被发现。在此前一项向三篇随机临床试验报告中插入错误的实验中，未经训练的人类审稿人的重大错误检出平均评分为27%。在这里，我们测试了15个大语言模型（LLMs），包括四个开放权重模型，是否能检出同样的错误。它们的重大错误检出评分范围为53%至96%。为降低记忆风险，我们在2026年发表的三项临床试验上重复了测试。评分范围为51%至99%，开放权重模型的评分范围为66%至87%。值得注意的是，对于未插入错误的对照报告，LLMs仍标记了2%至29%的错误类型，最常见的是结论未得到结果支持以及缺少筛查患者未入组的原因。在12个模型中，平均审阅时间范围为1.4至16.3分钟。Opus 5.5取得了最高的重大错误检出评分（99%），而GPT-6.1 Sol和GPT-6 Luna提供了具成本效益的替代方案，评分分别为92%和87%。总之，这些测试为专门的审阅模型提供了基准，并表明仅依赖人类同行评议可能会使可避免的方法学错误未被发现。

abstract: [Current urology reports] Advancements in technology have been at the heart of endourology for decades. With the introduction of new and novel technologies, endourology is rapidly changing. This review aims to address the recent innovations and technological advances in endourology by addressing four different areas where tangible outcome improvements are being seen: (1) diagnostic and detection methods; (2) intraoperative optimisation and procedural automation; (3) prediction of treatment outcomes; and (4) the use of generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Large Language Models (LLMs) for patients' education and monitoring. AI applications in endourology consistently demonstrate high diagnostic accuracy, with stone detection rates exceeding 95% across imaging modalities. Emerging tools include non-invasive analysis of stone composition and real-time intraoperative segmentation. Intraoperative improvements involve augmented reality-guided renal access, which has reduced puncture times, fluoroscopy exposure, and complications. New instruments, such as flexible, navigable suction devices (FANS) and intrarenal pressure (IRP) and temperature (IRT) monitoring systems, bring the field closer to achieving the endourological quadrifecta. Machine learning models trained on multicentre data can predict perioperative risks and personalise treatment, demonstrating similar effectiveness in managing stone disease. Additionally, generative AI and large language models are increasingly used for clinical documentation, patient communication, and outpatient workflows. However, concerns about hallucination, data privacy, and the need for human oversight remain significant in this growing area. Innovation, technology, and AI in endourology are advancing rapidly, introducing new ideas that are integrated into surgical procedures. These innovations offer numerous benefits to patients at various stages of treatment, leading to improved surgical results. Although combining these technologies can potentially maximise patient benefits, a careful and selective approach should be adopted, accompanied by thorough assessments before implementing these new innovations.
zh_abstract: [Current urology reports] 几十年来，技术进步一直是腔内泌尿外科（endourology）的核心。随着新的和新型技术的引入，腔内泌尿外科正在迅速变化。本综述旨在通过讨论四个已观察到切实结局改善的不同领域，来阐述腔内泌尿外科近期的创新和技术进步：（1）诊断与检测方法；（2）术中优化与操作自动化；（3）治疗结局预测；（4）使用生成式人工智能（AI）和大语言模型（LLMs）进行患者教育和监测。AI在腔内泌尿外科中的应用始终显示出高诊断准确性，在多种成像方式中结石检出率超过95%。新兴工具包括结石成分的无创分析和实时术中分割。术中改进涉及增强现实引导的肾脏入路，其缩短了穿刺时间、减少了透视暴露和并发症。新器械，如可弯曲、可导航的吸引装置（flexible, navigable suction devices, FANS）以及肾内压（intrarenal pressure, IRP）和温度（intrarenal temperature, IRT）监测系统，使该领域更接近实现腔内泌尿外科“四重目标”（endourological quadrifecta）。基于多中心数据训练的机器学习模型可预测围手术期风险并实现个体化治疗，在结石病管理中也显示出相似的有效性。此外，生成式AI和大语言模型越来越多地用于临床文档记录、患者沟通和门诊工作流程。然而，在这一不断发展的领域，幻觉、数据隐私以及需要人工监督等问题仍然突出。腔内泌尿外科中的创新、技术和AI正在迅速发展，引入新理念并整合到外科手术中。这些创新为处于治疗不同阶段的患者带来诸多益处，从而改善手术结果。尽管将这些技术结合起来可能最大化患者获益，但在实施这些新创新之前，应采取谨慎和选择性的方法，并辅以全面评估。

title: Building virtual cell dynamics that evolve with biological measurements

summary: 预印本提出智能体系统CellCompass，可将单细胞时间序列测量转化为动力学模型，并发布DynBench100基准。

abstract: Virtual cell models built from single-cell measurements need to predict how cells change over time, but new biological measurements often reveal dynamical relationships that existing models cannot express. Translating such measurements into dynamics therefore requires deciding what biological relation should be modeled, where it should enter the formulation and how its recovery should be validated. Here we present CellCompass, an agentic AI system that couples a scientific agent with an extensible dynamical engine for modeling state transitions and population change, along with fate and molecular readout. CellCompass reuses existing formulations when sufficient and designs, implements and refines new ones when experimental measurements introduce additional constraints. To assess this capability, we developed DynBench100, a benchmark of 100 simulated single-cell time-course scenarios with hidden dynamical ground truth. CellCompass achieved the highest aggregate performance among the tested general-purpose and biomedical agents across six dynamical tasks. Across four real single-cell studies, it retained an existing velocity-growth model to reconstruct context-dependent epithelial-mesenchymal transition and developed three new dynamical formulations for distinct experimental measurements. In drug-response data, incorporating metabolic RNA labeling reduced pulse-control identifiability error by 31.1%, revealing staged response programs and generating testable predictions for perturbing a candidate adaptive program. In hematopoietic lineage tracing, incorporating clonal barcodes improved clone-fate agreement by 54% over the strongest dynamical baseline, identifying early lineage priming among transcriptionally similar progenitors. Finally, in time-resolved CITE-seq data, CellCompass reduced future surface-protein distribution error by 13.2% for RNA-initialized trajectories, uncovering lineage-specific temporal offsets between transcriptional and protein programs. Together, CellCompass provides a framework in which virtual-cell dynamics can expand with the biological measurements used to constrain them.
zh_abstract: 由单细胞测量构建的虚拟细胞模型需要预测细胞如何随时间变化，但新的生物学测量常常揭示现有模型无法表达的动力学关系。因此，将此类测量转化为动力学需要决定应建模何种生物学关系、该关系应在何处进入公式表述，以及应如何验证其恢复。在此，我们提出CellCompass，一种智能体式AI系统，它将科学智能体与可扩展的动力学引擎耦合，用于建模状态转变和群体变化，以及命运和分子读数。CellCompass在足够时复用现有公式表述，并在实验测量引入额外约束时设计、实现和细化新的公式表述。为评估这一能力，我们开发了DynBench100，这是一个包含100个模拟单细胞时间过程场景且隐藏动力学真实值的基准。在六项动力学任务中，CellCompass在受测的通用和生物医学智能体中取得了最高总体性能。在四项真实单细胞研究中，它保留了现有的速度-生长模型以重建情境依赖的上皮-间质转化，并针对不同的实验测量开发了三种新的动力学公式表述。在药物反应数据中，纳入代谢RNA标记将脉冲控制可识别性误差降低了31.1%，揭示了分阶段反应程序，并为扰动一个候选适应性程序生成了可检验的预测。在造血谱系追踪中，纳入克隆条形码使克隆命运一致性比最强的动力学基线提高了54%，识别出转录相似祖细胞之间的早期谱系启动。最后，在时间分辨CITE-seq数据中，CellCompass将RNA初始化轨迹的未来表面蛋白分布误差降低了13.2%，揭示了转录程序与蛋白程序之间谱系特异性的时间偏移。总之，CellCompass提供了一个框架，使虚拟细胞动力学能够随着用于约束它们的生物学测量而扩展。

abstract: Despite rapid advances in large language models (LLMs), their deployment in the sports and health domain remains high-risk due to the absence of domain-specific evaluation benchmarks. Existing general-purpose benchmarks (e.g., MMLU and HELM) primarily assess broad knowledge and reasoning capabilities, but fail to capture critical domain requirements such as exercise safety, physiological appropriateness, personalization, and actionable coaching quality. This gap is particularly concerning in fitness and health applications, where incorrect or unsafe recommendations can lead to physical harm. To address this limitation, we introduce MoveBench, the first comprehensive benchmarking framework specifically designed for evaluating LLMs in sports and health coaching. The proposed benchmark integrates heterogeneous task formats, including multiple-choice questions (MCQs) and open-ended question answering (OpenQA), grounded in real-world user scenarios and paired with structured rubrics emphasizing safety compliance, scientific validity, and training logic. Through large-scale evaluation of 15 diverse LLMs on 809 questions with 5,012 rubric-level criteria, our results reveal substantial performance variability, particularly in safety awareness, structured program design, and personalization capability, highlighting a critical gap between knowing and doing. Our work establishes a foundational evaluation standard for sports and health LLM applications and provides a reproducible framework for advancing safe, reliable, and context-aware AI-driven coaching systems. Open resources are available at https://github.com/SatoSakula/MoveBench.
zh_abstract: 尽管大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）取得了快速进展，但由于缺乏领域特定的评估基准，其在体育与健康领域的部署仍具有高风险。现有的通用基准（例如MMLU和HELM）主要评估广泛的知识和推理能力，但未能捕捉关键领域要求，如运动安全性、生理适宜性、个性化以及可操作的指导质量。这一差距在健身和健康应用中尤其令人担忧，因为错误或不安全的建议可能导致身体伤害。为解决这一局限，我们推出MoveBench，这是首个专门用于评估LLMs在体育与健康指导中表现的综合基准框架。所提出的基准整合了异构任务格式，包括多项选择题（multiple-choice questions, MCQs）和开放式问答（open-ended question answering, OpenQA），以真实用户场景为基础，并配以强调安全合规性、科学有效性和训练逻辑的结构化评分细则。通过对15个多样化LLMs在809个问题及5,012条评分细则级标准上的大规模评估，我们的结果揭示了显著性能差异，尤其是在安全意识、结构化方案设计和个性化能力方面，凸显了“知”与“行”之间的关键差距。我们的工作为体育与健康LLM应用建立了基础评估标准，并为推进安全、可靠且情境感知的AI驱动指导系统提供了可复现框架。开放资源见https://github.com/SatoSakula/MoveBench。

abstract: [The Hastings Center report] Within public health, the contemporary discourse surrounding AI in this field is dominated by what this paper terms the "standard approach." In this frame, AI appears as a neutral tool to be evaluated for accuracy, privacy protection, and bias mitigation. When direct benefits outweigh direct harms, AI is described as an opportunity to improve public health practice. But the standard approach does not consider how public health's adoption of AI discloses and reinforces different accounts of the underlying purpose of the profession. Drawing insights from the communitarian thinker Wendell Berry, we demonstrate how AI does not merely improve efficiency and add capabilities but tends to align public health practice with purposes and assumptions that, when actualized, increasingly displace community power and authentic human presence. This tendency is clear in three commonly proposed applications of AI in public health practice: health education, community health assessments, and data analysis. Because the advent of AI offers an opportunity for greater technological efficiency, it offers the public health community the opportunity to reflect on what ultimate ends those efficiencies should be directed toward.

abstract: [Journal of gastroenterology and hepatology] Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) burdens the healthcare system, affecting millions of individuals worldwide with a potential progression to complications such as cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The World Health Organization launched the chronic viral hepatitis elimination plan which aimed to eliminate chronic hepatitis B virus by 2030, yet the goal has seemed to be far from reach with the remaining few years owing to different hurdles ranging from screening strategy and diagnosis to risk stratification for antiviral treatment and HCC surveillance. To refine the management of CHB, previous studies focused on identifying the at-risk populations and predictors for adverse outcomes using conventional statistical methods. With the emerging role of artificial intelligence (AI), there is further room to improve different aspects of screening and management. For instance, generative AI, such as large language models (LLMs), has been proven to have the ability to answer different clinical questions, assisting patients' and physicians' decision on various clinical scenarios. Different machine learning and deep learning models have also been developed to assess for liver fibrosis, as well as to aid segmentation of liver structures and detection of focal liver lesions through various imaging modalities. While different AI models have shown superior performance compared to those developed through traditional statistical models, the lack of standardized datasets in training cohorts and the unresolved concerns of hallucination of false information in LLMs pose challenges on applying AI in the current management of CHB, in which further studies are required to adopt AI into daily clinical practice.

abstract: Mass spectrometry-based peptide sequencing underpins proteomics. Database search confines to predefined candidates, whereas de novo peptide sequencing (DNPS) struggles with incomplete spectra. Existing hybrid methods use databases only for post hoc correction or retrieve previously identified spectra to guide decoding. We instead combine DNPS with a peptide prior: a language model fitted to a reference proteome, tolerating variants yet uncertain on strongly divergent sequences. Relative to prior-free DNPS, our implementation, PepPr, improved reference peptide identification and improved rather than suppressed variant identification. Using a related proteome as prior, it matched or outperformed homology-driven database search, and its gain over prior-free DNPS grew with relatedness. In antibody sequencing, it improved recovery of peptides spanning the variable-constant boundary, deamidation calls, and assembly, while preserving recall of hypervariable regions inaccessible to database search. Peptide priors thus bring reference knowledge into DNPS without limiting discovery.
zh_abstract: 基于质谱的肽段测序是蛋白质组学的基础。数据库搜索局限于预先定义的候选，而从头肽段测序（de novo peptide sequencing, DNPS）难以处理不完整的谱图。现有的混合方法仅将数据库用于事后校正，或检索先前鉴定的谱图来指导解码。我们则将DNPS与肽段先验结合：一个拟合到参考蛋白质组的语言模型，可容忍变异，但在高度分化的序列上不确定。相较于无先验的DNPS，我们的实现PepPr改善了参考肽段鉴定，并且改善而非抑制了变异鉴定。使用相关蛋白质组作为先验时，它匹配或优于同源性驱动的数据库搜索，并且其相对于无先验DNPS的增益随相关性增加而增大。在抗体测序中，它改善了跨越可变区-恒定区边界的肽段回收、脱酰胺判定和组装，同时保留了对数据库搜索无法触及的高变区的召回。因此，肽段先验将参考知识引入DNPS而不限制发现。

However, advances in stereotactic radiosurgery, immunotherapy, and targeted therapy have substantially altered the imaging appearance and treatment response patterns of BM, which are not fully captured by conventional imaging and conventional size-based response criteria. This review discusses the evolving role of MRI in BM, from optimized lesion detection to treatment response assessment. We review advanced contrast-enhanced MRI techniques, including three-dimensional turbo spin echo black-blood imaging and post-contrast T2-weighted FLAIR, as well as recent developments in artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted detection. We also examine limitations of RANO-BM and discuss the emerging role of AI-based volumetric analysis for quantitative longitudinal assessment. For differentiating radiation necrosis from tumor progression, we review diffusion and perfusion MRI, MR spectroscopy, and emerging approaches including chemical exchange saturation transfer imaging, radiomics, and tumor habitat analysis. Finally, we highlight how the integration of optimized MRI protocols, multi-parametric imaging, and validated AI-based quantitative tools may improve treatment response assessment and support more precise clinical decision-making for patients with BM.
zh_abstract: [Magma (New York, N.Y.)] 磁共振成像（MRI）对脑转移瘤（BM）的检出、治疗计划和疗效评估至关重要。然而，立体定向放射外科、免疫治疗和靶向治疗的进展已显著改变BM的影像学表现和治疗反应模式，而传统影像学和传统基于大小的疗效标准并不能完全反映这些变化。本综述讨论MRI在BM中不断演变的作用，从优化病灶检出到治疗反应评估。我们回顾先进的对比增强MRI技术，包括三维涡轮自旋回波黑血成像和对比增强后T2加权FLAIR，以及人工智能（AI）辅助检测的最新进展。我们还考察RANO-BM的局限性，并讨论基于AI的容积分析在定量纵向评估中的新兴作用。为鉴别放射性坏死与肿瘤进展，我们回顾扩散和灌注MRI、MR波谱，以及包括化学交换饱和转移成像、影像组学和肿瘤栖息地分析在内的新兴方法。最后，我们强调优化MRI方案、多参数成像和经过验证的基于AI的定量工具相结合，可能改善治疗反应评估，并支持对BM患者进行更精准的临床决策。

abstract: [Biomolecules] Therapeutic peptides combine biological specificity with chemical versatility, and artificial intelligence (AI) now contributes to their identification, design, and optimisation. Peptide discovery, however, cannot be reduced to generating amino-acid sequences: therapeutic performance also depends on chemistry, conformation, assay context, stability, delivery, safety, manufacturability, and in vivo exposure. This critical review examines AI use across the major peptide classes: receptor agonists, protein-protein interaction inhibitors, oncology and tumour-targeting peptides, antimicrobial and phenotype-driven peptides, delivery peptides, vaccine epitopes, self-assembling materials, and chemically constrained macrocycles. It compares sequence-based, chemical, graph, structure-aware, and multimodal representations across predictive, generative, and experimentally integrated workflows. Coverage spans recent general protein foundation, prediction, and design systems (ProtGPT2, ESM-2/ESM3, ProGen/ProGen2, ProteinMPNN, RFdiffusion, and AlphaFold 3) and peptide-focused methods (RFpeptides, PepFlow, and PepGLAD). Particular attention is given to benchmark integrity, the limits of structure prediction for short and non-canonical molecules, and the gap between retrospective and prospective evidence. To make claims comparable, the review adapts established reporting, validation, and readiness concepts into a peptide-specific, two-dimensional Peptide-AI Evidence Grid that separates methodological rigour (M0-M3) from translational depth (T0-T3), applies it to representative studies, and provides a checklist extending DOME, TRIPOD + AI, and FAIR guidance with the chemistry- and assay-specific items peptide work requires.
zh_abstract: [Biomolecules] 治疗性肽将生物特异性与化学多样性结合起来，而人工智能（AI）现在在其识别、设计和优化中发挥作用。然而，肽发现不能简化为生成氨基酸序列：治疗性能还取决于化学性质、构象、测定背景、稳定性、递送、安全性、可制造性和体内暴露。这篇批判性综述考察了 AI 在主要肽类别中的应用：受体激动剂、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用抑制剂、肿瘤学及肿瘤靶向肽、抗菌肽和表型驱动肽、递送肽、疫苗表位、自组装材料以及化学受限大环化合物。它比较了基于序列、化学、图、结构感知和多模态的表示在预测性、生成性和实验整合工作流程中的应用。覆盖范围涵盖近期通用蛋白质基础模型、预测与设计系统（ProtGPT2、ESM-2/ESM3、ProGen/ProGen2、ProteinMPNN、RFdiffusion 和 AlphaFold 3）以及肽聚焦方法（RFpeptides、PepFlow 和 PepGLAD）。特别关注基准完整性、结构预测对短分子和非经典分子的局限性，以及回顾性与前瞻性证据之间的差距。为使主张具有可比性，本综述将既有报告、验证和成熟度概念改编为肽特异性的二维 Peptide-AI Evidence Grid，将方法学严谨性（M0-M3）与转化深度（T0-T3）分开，将其应用于代表性研究，并提供一份清单，在 DOME、TRIPOD + AI 和 FAIR 指南基础上扩展，加入肽工作所需的化学和测定特异性条目。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Ruijin Hospital; conditions: Autoimmune Pancreatitis, Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma (PDAC); type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 690; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] Focal autoimmune pancreatitis (f-AIP) and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) exhibit substantial overlap in clinical manifestations and imaging features, posing a major diagnostic challenge in pancreatic diseases. Given the marked differences in treatment strategies and prognosis, accurate differentiation is essential to avoid unnecessary surgery and ensure timely initiation of anticancer treatment. This study aims to collect endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) images from patients with confirmed f-AIP or PDAC across multiple centers, using a previously established multicenter database. Data collected before January 2026 will be used to develop an artificial intelligence (AI) model based on EUS radiomics for differential diagnosis. Subsequently, prospectively collected data from participating centers from 2026 onward will be used for model testing and validation. The diagnostic performance of the model will be evaluated and compared with that of endoscopists with different levels of experience. Furthermore, this study will investigate the clinical value of interpretable radiomic features, with particular emphasis on challenging diagnostic scenarios, including IgG4-negative AIP, AIP with elevated carbohydrate antigen 19-9 (CA19-9) levels, and PDAC with imaging features resembling those of AIP. The ultimate goal is to provide a reliable tool for accurate, noninvasive preoperative differential diagnosis while promoting the standardization of multicenter AIP databases and the sharing and utilization of imaging data resources.

The study is planned to include 92 primiparous mothers allocated to intervention and control groups. The intervention involves an AI-based breastfeeding counseling chatbot developed using natural language processing (NLP) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technology. Precision medicine approaches are therefore needed to better account for this heterogeneity and tailor therapeutic strategies to individual patients. Virtual human twins represent one such approach, integrating multimodal clinical, biological, imaging, physiological, and omics data into patient-specific computational models to model disease mechanisms and predict individual therapeutic response. VITAL-HF is a prospective cohort pilot study designed to clinically evaluate the ability of the VITAL cardiovascular virtual human twin to predict individual response to spironolactone in patients with HF. Adult patients with HF with left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) \> 40% who have a clinical indication for spironolactone as part of routine care will be enrolled and followed for 3 months. Virtual twin predictions will be generated for research purposes only and will not influence treatment decisions or patient management.

abstract: [Journal of pediatric nursing] Infant feeding and nutrition are critical for growth, development, and long-term health outcomes. As paediatric nurses play a central role in infant monitoring and feeding practices, there is growing interest in innovative approaches to support early assessment and personalised nutritional care. Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly explored to support clinical decision-making; however, its applications in infant feeding and nutrition have not been comprehensively synthesised. To map AI applications in infant feeding and nutrition and examine their potential implications for clinical care and paediatric nursing practice. This scoping review followed Arksey and O'Malley's framework and adhered to the PRISMA-ScR guidelines. A comprehensive search of research databases was conducted across seven electronic databases, grey literature, and trial registers, including studies published from inception to 26 May 2026. Two reviewers independently screened titles and abstracts and extracted and synthesised data. Twenty-nine studies were included. Seven broad AI application areas were identified: 1) prediction and classification of nutritional status, 2) estimation and monitoring of growth, 3) providing nutritional recommendations, 4) analysing nutritional practices and variations, 5) suckling and feeding behaviour analysis, 6) feeding method and behaviour monitoring, and 7) prediction and classification of feeding status. AI demonstrates potential to support paediatric nurses and healthcare professionals by enabling more timely, personalised interventions to improve nutritional care and long-term infant health outcomes. However, current evidence remains largely developmental, highlighting the need for real-world clinical studies to determine the safety, effectiveness, and integration of AI technologies into paediatric care. abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing the way we discover anticancer drugs. It tackles the problems of traditional methods, such as prolonged timelines for drug development, higher costs, and substantial inter-patient heterogeneity. This review explains how AI is applied throughout the cancer drug pipeline. This includes target identification, virtual screening of compounds, molecular docking, and predicting pharmacokinetics. We explore how machine learning models speed up hit-to-lead optimization, improve clinical trial design by stratifying patients, and allow for real-time toxicity monitoring. A key focus is on integrating AI with multi-omics data, including proteomics, genomics, transcriptomics, and metabolomics, to support precision oncology and personalized treatments. We address important validation challenges, like model interpretability, data quality, and regulatory issues that must be solved before AI can be widely used in clinics. By summarizing current evidence and targeting research gaps, this review offers a clear view of how AI is enhancing the discovery, personalization, and validation of anticancer treatments.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] 人工智能（AI）正在改变我们发现抗癌药物的方式。它解决了传统方法的问题，例如药物开发周期延长、成本较高以及患者间异质性显著。本综述解释了AI如何应用于整个癌症药物研发管线。这包括靶点识别、化合物虚拟筛选、分子对接以及预测药代动力学。我们探讨了机器学习模型如何加速从命中到先导物的优化、通过患者分层改善临床试验设计，并实现实时毒性监测。一个关键重点是将AI与多组学数据整合，包括蛋白质组学、基因组学、转录组学和代谢组学，以支持精准肿瘤学和个性化治疗。我们讨论了重要的验证挑战，如模型可解释性、数据质量和监管问题，这些问题必须在AI广泛用于临床之前得到解决。通过总结当前证据并针对研究空白，本综述清晰呈现了AI如何增强抗癌治疗的发现、个性化和验证。

abstract: Background: Mathematical coupling and comparator selection are established concerns when a transcriptome response is defined as follow-up minus baseline. We assessed whether apparent within-cohort improvement survives matched constant-follow-up and scalar-shrinkage controls, and whether specified evaluation faults are detectable in an auditable vascular transcriptome benchmark. Results: Using eight frozen modules, 72 rosuvastatin pairs, 14 peripheral artery disease pairs, 20 repeated subject-held-out five-fold partitions, and 5,000 subject bootstrap draws of fixed losses, we compared 15 explicit specifications. Supporting post hoc analyses included 800 known-truth training/test simulations, annotation and input-ablation sensitivities, complete-tuning integrity checks, and an independent-source cross-sectional artery description. In GSE86216, nested follow-up ridge had lower observed repeated-CV mean absolute error than mean follow-up, 0.3280 versus 0.3405 (difference 0.0126; descriptive central 95% percentile range 0.0033-0.0224), while scalar shrinkage had lower observed error (0.3256). These ranges have no validated coverage guarantee. No full-matrix advantage was established; equivalence was not tested. In peripheral artery disease, nested ridge (0.3449) had slightly higher observed MAE than the median follow-up comparator (0.3409), and no advantage was established. Simulations illustrated how mean follow-up can outperform mean change without temporal signal, while the GSE281841 histological stenosis-grade description remained limited by anatomical imbalance, unconfirmed participant identity and an unresolved sample-count discrepancy. Conclusions: These retrospective, nonconfirmatory comparisons show modestly lower observed within-cohort error than constant-follow-up controls in one cohort, without established full-matrix advantage. They do not partition prediction into mathematical, technical and biological components. Independent longitudinal validation and clinical utility remain unestablished.
zh_abstract: 【背景】当转录组反应被定义为随访值减基线值时，数学耦合和比较器选择是既有的顾虑。我们评估了在匹配的恒定随访对照和标量收缩对照下，表观队列内改善是否仍存在，以及指定评估缺陷在可审计的血管转录组基准中是否可检测。【结果】使用八个冻结模块、72 个瑞舒伐他汀（rosuvastatin）配对、14 个外周动脉疾病（peripheral artery disease）配对、20 次重复的以受试者为留出单元的五折划分，以及 5,000 次固定损失的受试者 bootstrap 抽样，我们比较了 15 种明确设定。支持性事后分析包括 800 次已知真值的训练/测试模拟、注释和输入消融敏感性分析、完整调优完整性检查，以及独立来源的横断面动脉描述。在 GSE86216 中，嵌套随访岭回归（nested follow-up ridge）的观察重复交叉验证（repeated-CV）平均绝对误差低于均值随访，0.3280 对 0.3405（差值 0.0126；描述性中心 95% 百分位范围 0.0033–0.0224），而标量收缩的观察误差更低（0.3256）。这些范围没有经过验证的覆盖保证。未确立全矩阵优势；未检验等效性。在外周动脉疾病中，嵌套岭回归（0.3449）的观察 MAE 略高于中位数随访比较器（0.3409），且未确立优势。模拟说明，在没有时间信号的情况下，均值随访可优于均值变化；而 GSE281841 的组织学狭窄分级描述仍受解剖学不平衡、参与者身份未确认以及未解决的样本计数差异所限。【结论】这些回顾性、非确证性比较显示，在一个队列中，观察到的队列内误差较恒定随访对照略有降低，但未确立全矩阵优势。这些比较未将预测分解为数学、技术和生物学成分。独立的纵向验证和临床效用仍未确立。

abstract: [Dentistry journal] Objective: The objective of this study was to evaluate the diagnostic performance of GPT-5.2 Thinking in identifying oral potentially malignant disorders within a patient sample that also included oral carcinomas and other oral cavity lesions, using intraoral photographs and associated clinical data. Methods: This retrospective exploratory diagnostic accuracy study included 103 oral lesions: 69 oral potentially malignant disorders, 25 oral carcinomas, and 9 other oral pathologies. Each case was assessed in three independent sessions, and the majority diagnosis was compared with the final clinical and/or histopathological reference diagnosis. Results: For oral potentially malignant disorders, sensitivity was 92.75%, specificity was 88.24%, accuracy was 91.26%, positive predictive value was 94.12%, negative predictive value was 85.71%, and Cohen's kappa was 0.804. Sensitivity was 81.82% for homogeneous leukoplakia, 78.57% for non-homogeneous leukoplakia, and 86.36% for oral lichen planus. For oral carcinomas, sensitivity was 84.00%, specificity was 97.44%, accuracy was 94.17%, positive predictive value was 91.30%, negative predictive value was 95.00%, and Cohen's kappa was 0.837. Conclusions: GPT-5.2 Thinking showed promising diagnostic performance in this exploratory case-enriched dataset, but predictive values require validation in representative clinical populations.
zh_abstract: [Dentistry journal] 【目的】本研究旨在使用口内照片及相关临床数据，在同时包含口腔癌和其他口腔病变的患者样本中，评估GPT-5.2 Thinking识别口腔潜在恶性疾患的诊断性能。【方法】这项回顾性探索性诊断准确性研究纳入103个口腔病变：69个口腔潜在恶性疾患、25个口腔癌和9个其他口腔病理。每个病例在三个独立场次中评估，多数诊断与最终临床和/或组织病理学参考诊断进行比较。【结果】对于口腔潜在恶性疾患，敏感性为92.75%，特异性为88.24%，准确性为91.26%，阳性预测值为94.12%，阴性预测值为85.71%，Cohen's kappa为0.804。均质型白斑的敏感性为81.82%，非均质型白斑为78.57%，口腔扁平苔藓为86.36%。对于口腔癌，敏感性为84.00%，特异性为97.44%，准确性为94.17%，阳性预测值为91.30%，阴性预测值为95.00%，Cohen's kappa为0.837。【结论】GPT-5.2 Thinking在这个探索性病例富集数据集中显示出有前景的诊断性能，但预测值需要在具有代表性的临床人群中验证。

abstract: [Nurse education today] To identify distinct profiles of artificial intelligence (AI) readiness among nursing interns, to explore the relationship between these profiles and critical thinking ability, and to examine the factors associated with profile membership. The integration of AI into healthcare and nursing education necessitates that nursing students develop AI readiness. Critical thinking is a core competency for clinical decision-making and professional practice. Understanding how AI readiness profiles relate to critical thinking can inform tailored educational interventions. A cross-sectional survey study. A total of 458 nursing interns were recruited via convenience sampling from a teaching hospital in China. Data were collected using the Medical Artificial Intelligence Readiness Scale and the Simplified Critical Thinking Scale. Latent profile analysis (LPA) and multinomial logistic regression were performed. Three distinct AI readiness profiles were identified: "Cognition-Deficient Type" (35.6%), "Moderately Balanced Type" (48.0%), and "Comprehensive Excellence Type" (16.4%). Critical thinking scores differed significantly across profiles (p < 0.001), with higher AI readiness associated with stronger critical thinking ability. In terms of other related variables, there were significant differences between the groups in terms of satisfaction with the nursing profession, exposure to AI-medicine interdisciplinary course, attitude towards AI application in healthcare (p < 0.001). Nursing interns exhibit heterogeneous AI readiness levels, which are positively associated with critical thinking. Tailored educational strategies should be developed to enhance both AI readiness and critical thinking skills.
zh_abstract: [Nurse Education Today] 旨在识别护理实习生中人工智能（AI）准备度的不同特征剖面，探讨这些剖面与批判性思维能力之间的关系，并检验与剖面归属相关的因素。AI融入医疗保健和护理教育要求护生培养AI准备度。批判性思维是临床决策和专业实践的核心能力。理解AI准备度剖面与批判性思维的关系可为量身定制的教育干预提供依据。一项横断面调查研究。通过方便抽样从中国一家教学医院招募了458名护理实习生。数据使用医学人工智能准备度量表和简化批判性思维量表收集。进行了潜在剖面分析（LPA）和多分类逻辑回归。识别出三种不同的AI准备度剖面：“认知不足型”（35.6%）、“中等均衡型”（48.0%）和“全面优秀型”（16.4%）。不同剖面间的批判性思维得分存在显著差异（p < 0.001），较高的AI准备度与较强的批判性思维能力相关。在其他相关变量方面，各组在护理职业满意度、是否接触过AI-医学跨学科课程、对AI应用于医疗保健的态度方面存在显著差异（p < 0.001）。护理实习生表现出异质性的AI准备度水平，且其与批判性思维呈正相关。应制定量身定制的教育策略，以同时提升AI准备度和批判性思维技能。

abstract: [Resuscitation plus] Assessment of simulated cardiac arrest performance is resource-intensive and subject to inter-rater variability. We evaluated whether a multimodal artificial intelligence (AI) system could score video-recorded cardiac arrest megacode simulations with agreement comparable to expert raters. Six scripted megacode simulations (three ventricular fibrillation, three pulseless electrical activity) representing exemplar, guideline-deviation and non-technical-deficiency performance were scored by two ACLS instructors using a validated team-leader checklist; consensus ratings served as the reference. Two operators analysed each video with Gemini 1.5 Pro at three temperature settings (504 item-level ratings). We calculated Cohen's kappa, Gwet's AC1, and sensitivity and specificity for identifying performed and omitted actions, and compared AI self-reported confidence between correct and incorrect ratings. Expert inter-rater agreement was κ = 0.78 (95% CI 0.64-0.93). AI-expert agreement was κ = 0.62 (95% CI 0.49-0.75; range 0.40-0.86 across configurations) and AC1 = 0.77. The AI identified performed actions with high sensitivity (0.98, 95% CI 0.96-0.99) but detected omitted actions poorly (specificity 0.58, 95% CI 0.44-0.72), particularly omissions defined by timing or sequence. Temperature had no consistent effect. Incorrect ratings of actions as performed carried lower mean self-reported confidence than correct ones (93.6 vs 98.1), but 48% were made with maximal confidence. A multimodal AI system reliably confirmed completed actions but frequently failed to detect omitted actions, yielding moderate overall agreement that was below expert-expert agreement. Current systems may support, but not replace, expert assessment of cardiac arrest simulation.
zh_abstract: [Resuscitation plus] 评估模拟心脏骤停表现资源密集，且受评分者间变异影响。我们评估了多模态人工智能（AI）系统能否对视频记录的心脏骤停 megacode 模拟进行评分，并与专家评分者具有可比的一致性。六段脚本化 megacode 模拟（三段心室颤动、三段无脉性电活动）分别代表范例性、指南偏离性和非技术缺陷性表现，由两名 ACLS 导师使用经过验证的团队领导者核对表评分；共识评分作为参考。两名操作者使用 Gemini 1.5 Pro 在三种温度设置下分析每个视频（504 个条目级评分）。我们计算了 Cohen's kappa、Gwet's AC1，以及识别已执行和遗漏动作的灵敏度和特异度，并比较 AI 在正确与错误评分之间自报置信度。专家评分者间一致性为 κ = 0.78（95% CI 0.64-0.93）。AI 与专家一致性为 κ = 0.62（95% CI 0.49-0.75；不同配置范围为 0.40-0.86），AC1 = 0.77。AI 识别已执行动作具有高灵敏度（0.98，95% CI 0.96-0.99），但对遗漏动作的检测较差（特异度 0.58，95% CI 0.44-0.72），尤其是由时机或顺序定义的遗漏。温度没有一致影响。将动作错误评为已执行时，其平均自报置信度低于正确评分（93.6 对 98.1），但 48% 是以最高置信度作出的。多模态 AI 系统能可靠确认已完成的动作，但常未能检测遗漏动作，产生中等总体一致性，低于专家-专家一致性。当前系统可能支持但不能替代专家对心脏骤停模拟的评估。

abstract: [In silico pharmacology] The conventional drug discovery process is intricate, expensive and time-consuming with high attrition rates. Addressing these inefficiencies has spelled the dawn of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) as game-changers in rational drug design. The review highlights the revolutionary potential of AI techniques such as deep learning and generative models in drug discovery and development. We discuss how AI improves protein-ligand interaction predictions and quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) modelling, as well as virtual screening, in drug discovery. In addition, AI can significantly accelerate lead optimization by predicting critical absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) properties early in the process, allowing for prioritization of promising candidates before time-consuming experimental testing. Although these advancements have been made there still remain several limitations to how broad AI systems are applied in the real world, ranging from data bias and model reliability to the non-interpretability of "black box" neural networks. To overcome these regulatory and ethical challenges, Explainable AI (XAI) must be implemented. In the end, the combination of AI with multi-omics and other technologies such as quantum computing will bring personalized therapy at a much more specific level and significantly shorten the development and research times and costs.
zh_abstract: [In silico pharmacology] 传统药物发现过程复杂、昂贵且耗时，并具有高淘汰率。为解决这些低效问题，人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）作为合理药物设计中的变革者应运而生。本综述强调深度学习（deep learning）和生成模型（generative models）等AI技术在药物发现与开发中的革命性潜力。我们讨论AI如何改进药物发现中的蛋白质-配体相互作用预测和定量构效关系（QSAR）建模，以及虚拟筛选。此外，AI可通过在早期预测关键的吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）性质，显著加速先导化合物优化，从而在耗时的实验测试之前优先选择有前景的候选物。尽管已取得这些进展，AI系统在现实世界中的广泛应用仍存在若干局限，从数据偏倚和模型可靠性到“黑箱”神经网络不可解释性。为克服这些监管和伦理挑战，必须实施可解释AI（XAI）。最终，AI与多组学以及量子计算等其他技术的结合，将在更具体的层面实现个性化治疗，并显著缩短开发和研究时间与成本。
